entities.name: Pere Riutort i Mestre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pere Riutort i Mestre was a Spanish priest, pedagogue, philologue, and liturgist. He was one of the main promoters of the Catalan language in Majorca and also in the Valencian Community, where he had lived since 1971.
